title: OpenPlanning Document Schema v1
description: Loads documents.Document records into a municipality. Natural key is (municipality, sha256). Content-addressable: same bytes yield the same raw_key in every environment, so cross-env portability is a single R2 prefix sync of documents/{subdomain}/by-sha/.

parcel_ref.description: See parcel/v1#/$defs/parcel_ref for the canonical definition. Structured natural-key reference: {street_number?, street_name, street_suffix?, city, state}.

application_ref.description: Reference to an Application within the municipality. Resolved within the named jurisdiction by application_number, then file_number, then title.

document.description: A single document. Identity is (municipality, sha256). source_url is provenance; raw_key is storage and is conventionally documents/{subdomain}/by-sha/{sha256}.{ext} so it is derivable from sha256. M2M edges (parcels, applications) are additive ,  each load appends links, never removes them. Re-loading the same fixture is idempotent.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of file contents. Globally unique per byte sequence.

source_url.description: Canonical public URL the document was fetched from. Provenance, not storage. Blank when the document originated as an upload with no public URL.

raw_key.description: R2 storage key. Conventionally documents/{subdomain}/by-sha/{sha256}.{ext}. Apply checks for the bytes at this key in the target environment's R2 bucket.

document_type.description: Document type. Resolved to DocumentCategory by slug.

discovered_from.description: sha256 of the parent document in the discovery tree. Resolved to a Document FK via (municipality, sha256). Single-parent only: if reachable from multiple parents, the first one seen during discovery wins. Nullable: root documents have no parent.

synopsis.description: AI-generated short summary (one or two sentences) for cards and previews.

description.description: AI-generated longer description for the document detail page.

parcels.description: Parcels this document is *about* as subject matter (plats, surveys, traffic studies, site plans). Distinct from DocumentReference (NER mentions in text) and from Application.documents (workflow attachment). Edges are added, never replaced ,  multiple fixtures can each contribute parcel links to the same document over time.

applications.description: Applications this document is part of as a submission/review artifact. Edges are added, never replaced. Equivalent to setting application/v1.documents from the document side; useful when authoring per-meeting document fixtures.
